summary: צַד denotes a side of an object or structure. In Genesis 6:16 it identifies the part of the ark where Noah is to put the doorway.

senses.definition: A lateral face of an object or structure.

evidence.note: The instruction places פֶתַח הַתֵּבָה, the ark’s doorway, בְּצִדָּהּ, in its side.

note: Root (2026-11-21): Kept under the geminate צדד: the biblical Aramaic צַד "side" (Dan 6:5; 7:25) is the same word and goes in the same entry.
